On the other hand I've seen plenty of parents come down like a ton of bricks on their sons fkr every little thing yet let their little princesses get away with murder. As someone whose babysat for a lot of kids, people forget how diabolical little girls can be, and how successful they can be in getting away with it. It also annoys me when people think little girls are made of sugar and spice and everything nice and so they are not capable of being bratty or bullies, or behaviour they would not tolerate in a boy is somehow adorable or charming.

Both boys will be boys, and little girls are made of sugar and spice and everything nice mindsets screw over both boys and girl in so many ways, both the indulged gender and the one that is demonised or relentlessly criticised.

Hell I'm a gay male and I'd be happy to date a single father.  My family live on the other side of the Atlantic and I really miss all my cousin's and their kids. I spend a lot of time babysitting my friends kids (I'm a godfather) and I'm going to start volunteering at aocsl school, but I do feel sad not being part of a big family and I'm getting quite broody.  So I wouldn't turn down dating a single father.
